description: Overwrite a file to hide its contents, and optionally delete it
name: shred

options.description: Change permissions to allow writing if necessary
name: --force
-f

options.description: Overwrite N times instead of the default (3)
name: --iterations
-n

options.description: Shred this many bytes (suffixes like K, M, G accepted)
name: --size
-s

args.description: 'unlink' => use a standard unlink call, 'wipe' => also first obfuscate bytes in the name, 'wipesync' => also sync each obfuscated byte to the device
args.name: HOW

options.description: Like -u but give control on HOW to delete
options.name: --remove

options.description: Do not round file sizes up to the next full block; this is the default for non-regular files
name: --exact
-x

options.description: Add a final overwrite with zeros to hide shredding
name: --zero
-z
